title: Rubric - Framing
evidence: All criteria are framed as positive assertions of what should be present or true: 'Output includes...', 'contains...lines in the prescribed format', 'shows a 3D bomb model', 'shows board tokens rendered as', 'shows a large colored ring', 'shows the HUD counters legible', 'shows a framed play area'. No criteria are framed as negatives ('should not', 'must not') except where logically necessary (criterion 19: 'no text clipped, truncated, or overlapping' — this is a quality assertion, not a negative framing). No criteria impose unnecessary constraints beyond what the prompt requests.
